title: Non-record 10min/16MB: BRLM SAGE Chunk4 causal gate (1xH100, val_bpb 1.26461)
author: FF-GardenFn

data.description: Bifurcated recurrent LM with chunk-level recurrent/broadcast side-channel gating (SAGE-bus) over local hidden states.
Causal within-chunk routing gate using cummax so each position only depends on route signals from earlier positions in the same chunk.

novel_contributions: BRLM SAGE chunk4 architecture with deterministic chunk-level side-channel routing
Fixing the within-chunk gate to be causal via cummax-based gating
Legalized version of a previously non-causal chunk4 SAGE prototype
Achieved 1.26460519 val_bpb under the 16MB artifact cap
